tools.name: section_categories
tools.description: 列出国标型钢全部类别（HW/HM/HN、工字钢、槽钢、角钢、C/Z型钢、方管、矩形管）及库存规格总数。List all standard section categories and total count of stored specifications.

tools.name: section_search
tools.description: 按类别（category）或关键词（query）搜索国标型钢规格，返回型号、标准、尺寸与每米重量。类别示例：HN / 工字钢 / 槽钢 / 等边角钢 / C型钢 / 方管。关键词可匹配型号片段，如 "HN400" 或 "200×200"。Search GB steel sections by category or keyword; returns designation, standard, dimensions, kg/m.

tools.name: section_lookup
tools.description: 按精确型号查国标型钢截面特性：A(cm²)、Ix/Iy(cm⁴)、Wx/Wy(cm³)、ix/iy(cm)、每米重量 kg/m。型号写法用 × 分隔，如 HN400×200×8×13、HW250×250×9×14、L50×5、C140×50×20×2.5。Look up full section properties for an exact GB designation.

tools.name: section_welded_i
tools.description: 由总高 hw、腹板厚 tw、翼缘宽 bf、翼缘厚 tf（mm）计算焊接工字形截面特性。Compute section properties of a welded I-section from plate dimensions (mm).

tools.name: section_welded_box
tools.description: 由总高 h、总宽 b、腹板厚 tw、翼缘厚 tf（mm）计算焊接箱形截面特性。Compute section properties of a welded box section from plate dimensions (mm).

tools.name: weight_calculate
tools.description: 计算常用钢材理论重量。shape 可选：plate钢板 / round圆钢 / square方钢 / flat扁钢 / hex六角钢 / oct八角钢 / rebar螺纹钢 / pipe圆管 / squareTube方管 / rectTube矩形管 / cProfile C型钢 / zProfile Z型钢 / weldedI焊接工字 / weldedBox焊接箱形 / standard国标型钢库（按型号）。尺寸单位 mm，长度 m。Calculate theoretical weight (kg/m, kg, tonnes) for common steel shapes or GB sec

tools.name: weight_materials
tools.description: 列出内置材质密度表（Q235/Q355、304、316、铝、铜）与默认值。List supported material densities.
